step3-enable-clippy-lints.description: Configure clippy to enforce Chaos compliance (P0 critical violations as errors)
step3-enable-clippy-lints.clippy-configuration:
# Create .cargo/config.toml (or update existing) cat > .cargo/config.toml <<'EOF' [target.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu] rustflags = [ # P0 Critical Violations (DENY - compilation blockers) "-D", "clippy::capsule-mutex-violation", # NO Mutex/RwLock allowed "-D", "clippy::capsule-unaligned-violation", # MUST be cache-aligned "-D", "clippy::capsule-missing-generation", # MUST have generation counter "-D", "clippy::capsule-non-atomic-field", # All fields MUST be atomic
# P1 High Priority (WARN - fix before production) "-W", "clippy::missing-capsule-verification", # Derive or manual verification required "-W", "clippy::capsule-missing-repr-c", # MUST have #[repr(C)] "-W", "clippy::capsule-scattered-atomics", # Use DualAtomicU64 pattern "-W", "clippy::capsule-incorrect-padding", # Padding must match calculated size ] EOF
step3-enable-clippy-lints.commands:
# Install custom clippy lint (one-time setup) cd /home/samuel/Primitives/clippy-capsule-verify cargo build --release export CLIPPY_DRIVER_PATH=$PWD/target/release/clippy-capsule-verify
# Run clippy with custom lints cd /home/samuel/Primitives/atomic_capsule cargo clippy --all-features -- \ -D clippy::capsule-mutex-violation \ -D clippy::capsule-unaligned-violation \ -D clippy::capsule-missing-generation \ -D clippy::capsule-non-atomic-field

step4-fix-violations.description: Address all clippy violations (automated patterns for common fixes)

pattern.name: Mutex to Atomic
pattern.frequency: High (20-30% of capsules in legacy code)

code-changes.change: Replace field type: Mutex<T> → Atomic[U64|U32|U8|Ptr] depending on T

pattern.automated-fix:
# Pattern: Mutex<u64> → AtomicU64 sed -i 's/Mutex<u64>/AtomicU64/g' src/path/to/file.rs sed -i 's/\.lock()\.unwrap()/.load(Ordering::Acquire)/g' src/path/to/file.rs sed -i 's/\*\.lock()\.unwrap() = \(.*\)/.store(\1, Ordering::Release)/g' src/path/to/file.rs
# Pattern: Mutex<u32> → AtomicU32 sed -i 's/Mutex<u32>/AtomicU32/g' src/path/to/file.rs
# Pattern: RwLock<T> → AtomicPtr<T> (for heap-allocated data) sed -i 's/RwLock<\(.*\)>/AtomicPtr<\1>/g' src/path/to/file.rs

pattern.name: Add Padding
pattern.after: #[repr(C, align(64))] #[derive(ComputationalCapsule)] pub struct UnderPaddedCapsule { state: AtomicU64, // 8 bytes counter: AtomicU32, // 4 bytes _padding: [u8; 52], // ← Fixed: Padding to 64 bytes }
pattern.automated-calculation:
# Use fix_padding_fields tool for automatic calculation cd /home/samuel/Primitives/tools/fix_padding_fields cargo run -- /home/samuel/Primitives/atomic_capsule/src/path/to/file.rs
# Manual calculation (if tool unavailable) python3 -c " import sys alignment = int(sys.argv[1]) fields_size = int(sys.argv[2]) padding = alignment - (fields_size % alignment) print(f'_padding: [u8; {padding}]') " 64 12 # Output: _padding: [u8; 52]

pattern.name: Add Generation Counter
pattern.before: #[repr(C, align(64))] #[derive(ComputationalCapsule)] pub struct NoGenerationCapsule { state: AtomicU64, data: AtomicU64, _padding: [u8; 48], // ← Will need to shrink by 4 bytes }
pattern.after: #[repr(C, align(64))] #[derive(ComputationalCapsule)] pub struct NoGenerationCapsule { state: AtomicU64, data: AtomicU64, generation: AtomicU32, // ← TOCTOU prevention (4 bytes) _padding: [u8; 44], // ← Adjusted: 48 - 4 = 44 }

rationale.pattern: Increment generation on every state update (monotonic counter)
rationale.validation: Compare generation before/after CAS to detect concurrent modifications

pattern.name: Fix Non-Atomic Fields
pattern.before: #[repr(C, align(64))] #[derive(ComputationalCapsule)] pub struct MixedFieldsCapsule { count: u64, // ← P0 violation: Not atomic state: AtomicU32, // ← OK: Atomic flag: bool, // ← P0 violation: Not atomic _padding: [u8; 47], }
pattern.after: #[repr(C, align(64))] #[derive(ComputationalCapsule)] pub struct MixedFieldsCapsule { count: AtomicU64, // ← Fixed: Atomic state: AtomicU32, // ← OK: Already atomic flag: AtomicBool, // ← Fixed: Atomic _padding: [u8; 47], // ← Same padding (sizes unchanged) }

exceptions.exception: Padding fields: _padding: [u8; N] is allowed (non-accessed data)
Const arrays: [T; N] allowed if T is Copy and never mutated

pattern.name: Add #[repr(C)]
pattern.frequency: Low (5-10%, usually forgotten in new code)

rationale.requirement: #[repr(C)] ensures predictable field layout across compiler versions
Required for mmap persistence (T9 capsules) - layout must be stable
Required for FFI interop (cross-language capsule access)

pattern.automated-fix: # Add #[repr(C)] to all #[repr(align(...))] attributes sed -i 's/#\[repr(align(\([0-9]*\)))\]/#[repr(C, align(\1))]/g' src/**/*.rs

pattern.name: Consolidate Atomics (DualAtomicU64)
pattern.before: #[repr(C, align(64))] #[derive(ComputationalCapsule)] pub struct ScatteredAtomicsCapsule { state: AtomicU8, // 1 byte (8 bits) count: AtomicU16, // 2 bytes (16 bits) flags: AtomicU32, // 4 bytes (32 bits) generation: AtomicU32, // 4 bytes (32 bits) _padding: [u8; 51], // Total: 1+2+4+4 = 11 bytes }

benefits.benefit: Reduced cache pressure: 4 cache lines → 1 cache line
Atomic snapshot: Read all fields in 2 loads (16 bytes total)
Better NUMA performance: Single aligned 16B block vs scattered fields

limitations.limitation: Field sizes must fit in 64 bits (or split across primary/secondary)
Only worth it for 3+ separate atomics (overhead otherwise)

step4-fix-violations.automated-workflow:
# Step 1: Identify all violations cargo clippy --all-features 2>&1 | tee clippy-violations.txt
# Step 2: Count violations by type grep -o "capsule-[a-z-]*-violation" clippy-violations.txt | sort | uniq -c
# Step 3: Fix P0 violations first (scripted where possible) # Example: Replace all Mutex<u64> with AtomicU64 find src -name "*.rs" -exec sed -i 's/Mutex<u64>/AtomicU64/g' {} \; find src -name "*.rs" -exec sed -i 's/\.lock()\.unwrap()/.load(Ordering::Acquire)/g' {} \;
# Step 4: Run fix_padding_fields tool for padding violations cd /home/samuel/Primitives/tools/fix_padding_fields for file in $(grep "capsule-incorrect-padding" ../clippy-violations.txt | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u); do cargo run -- "$file" done
# Step 5: Manually add generation counters (requires logic changes) # (No automated fix - review each capsule individually)
# Step 6: Validate all fixes cargo clippy --all-features -- \ -D clippy::capsule-mutex-violation \ -D clippy::capsule-unaligned-violation \ -D clippy::capsule-missing-generation \ -D clippy::capsule-non-atomic-field
# Step 7: Run full test suite cargo test --all-features

pattern2-add-padding.description: Calculate and add correct padding for cache-line alignment
pattern2-add-padding.automated-tool:
# Use fix_padding_fields tool for automatic calculation cd /home/samuel/Primitives/tools/fix_padding_fields
# Single file fix cargo run -- /path/to/capsule.rs
# Batch fix all capsules find ../atomic_capsule/src -name "*capsule*.rs" | while read file; do cargo run -- "$file" done
# Manual calculation (Python one-liner) python3 -c " alignment = 64 field_sizes = [8, 8, 4] # List all field sizes total = sum(field_sizes) padding = alignment - (total % alignment) print(f'Fields: {total} bytes, Padding: {padding} bytes, Total: {total + padding} bytes') " # Output: Fields: 20 bytes, Padding: 44 bytes, Total: 64 bytes

rollback-plan.description: Safe rollback to manual verification if migration issues discovered

step.description: Restore manual verification macros from git history
step.commands:
# Identify last commit before migration git log --oneline --grep="derive" -n 1
# Revert all files to pre-migration state git revert <commit-hash>
# Or selectively restore verification macros git checkout <commit-hash> -- src/**/*capsule*.rs

# Remove all derive attributes (automated) find src -name "*.rs" -exec sed -i '/^#\[derive(ComputationalCapsule)\]/d' {} \;
# Verify removal grep -r "derive(ComputationalCapsule)" src # Should return 0 results

# Re-add manual verification macros (manual or from backup) # Example: For each capsule struct, add at end of file: # crate::verification::verify_capsule_properties!(CapsuleName, alignment, size);
# Or restore from backup file cp backup/verification_macros.rs src/verification/mod.rs

# Compile with manual verification cargo build --lib --release
# Run full test suite cargo test --all-features
# Verify no derive attributes remain grep -r "derive(ComputationalCapsule)" src # Should return 0 results
# Verify manual macros restored grep -r "verify_capsule_properties" src | wc -l # Should return >0 (number of capsules)
